request.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates programming worked examples into other natural languages, maintaining both technical accuracy and the original code formatting.

[[TASK-DEFINITION]] You will be given a worked example. Your job is to translate the [[WORKED-EXAMPLE]] according to the [[TASK-INSTRUCTIONS]]. [[WORKED-EXAMPLE]] [[PROGRAM-NAME]] Finding the Smallest Divisor of a Positive Number [[PROGRAM-DESCRIPTION]] Construct a program that finds the smallest divisor (other than 1) of a positive number. For example, the smallest divisor of 4 is 2. [[SOURCE-CODE]] [[LINE01]] #Step 1: Assign initial values to the variables which we need for this program [[LINE02]] num = 15 [[LINE03]] divisor = 2 [[LINE04]] #Step 2: Find the smallest divisor of the number [[LINE05]] while num % divisor != 0 : [[LINE06]] divisor += 1 [[LINE07]] print("The smallest divisor of", num, "is", divisor) [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]] [[LINE02.EXPL1]] We define variable num to store the number that we want to find its smallest divisor. We could initialize it to any positive integer greater than 1. In this program, we initialize variable num to 15. [[LINE03.EXPL1]] We define variable divisor to store the smallest divisor of the number. We initialize variable divisor by 2 because we want to find the smallest divisor except 1. [[LINE05.EXPL1]] We need to increment the divisor repeatedly as long as the divisor is not a factor of the number. Therefore, we need to use a loop structure. Since we don't know ahead of time how many times the loop will be repeated, we need to use a while loop. The condition in the while loop tests whether the body of the loop should be repeated, so it should test whether the divisor is not a factor of the number.

We could check whether the divisor is not a factor of the number by computing the remainder of the division of the number by the divisor. [[LINE05.EXPL2]] The body of the while loop is repeated as long as the divisor is not a factor of the number. The loop terminates when the loop condition evaluates to False, that is when the divisor is a factor of the number.
In this program, the while loop executes once and updates the value of divisor to 3. After that, the loop stops repeating because 3 is a factor of 15 and the loop test will be evaluated as False. [[LINE05.EXPL3]] Also note that the % operator returns the remainder of the division. [[LINE06.EXPL1]] When the divisor is not a factor of the number, we increment the variable divisor by 1. [[LINE06.EXPL2]] The += operator adds 1 to the value of variable divisor and the result is stored back into the variable divisor. Therefore, it is functionally equivalent to the statement divisor = divisor + 1. [[LINE07.EXPL1]] This statement prints to the default standard output stream the smallest divisor of the number.
The printed text shows the arguments of the print function separated by the default delimiter (i.e., single space character) and followed by the end-of-line character at the end. [[LINE-DISTRACTORS]] [[DIST1.LC]] while num % divisor >= 0 : [[DIST2.LC]] while num % divisor == 0 : [[DIST3.LC]] while num / divisor > 0 : [[DIST4.LC]] while num / divisor != 0 : [[TASK-INSTRUCTIONS]] Translate the given worked example into Arabic. Be sure to specifically translate the sections labeled [[PROGRAM-NAME]], [[PROGRAM-DESCRIPTION]], [[SOURCE-CODE]], [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]], and [[LINE-DISTRACTORS]]. In the [[SOURCE-CODE]] section, translate ONLY user-defined string-literals and comments; make sure they are ASCII-folded (i.e., remove any accents or non-ASCII characters). Preserve the original format and Do NOT add, remove, or change any content beyond translation.

[[SOURCE-CODE]] [[LINE01]] #Khatwa 1: Takhsees al-qiyam al-ibtida'iyya lil-mutaghayyirat allati nahtajuha lihadha al-barnamaj [[LINE02]] num = 15 [[LINE03]] divisor = 2 [[LINE04]] #Khatwa 2: Ijid asghar qasim lil-adad [[LINE05]] while num % divisor != 0 : [[LINE06]] divisor += 1 [[LINE07]] print("Asghar qasim lel-adad", num, "huwa", divisor) [[LINE-EXPLANATIONS]] [[LINE02.EXPL1]] نعرّف المتغير num لتخزين العدد الذي نريد إيجاد أصغر قاسمه. يمكن تهيئته لأي عدد صحيح موجب أكبر من 1. في هذا البرنامج، نهيئ المتغير num إلى 15. [[LINE03.EXPL1]] نعرّف المتغير divisor لتخزين أصغر قاسم للعدد. نهيئ المتغير divisor بالقيمة 2 لأننا نريد إيجاد أصغر قاسم باستثناء 1. [[LINE05.EXPL1]] نحتاج إلى زيادة قيمة divisor مرارا طالما أن divisor ليس عاملًا للعدد. لذلك نستخدم هيكل حلقة. بما أننا لا نعرف مسبقًا عدد مرات التكرار، نستخدم حلقة while. الحالة في حلقة while تختبر ما إذا كان يجب تكرار جسم الحلقة، لذا يجب أن تختبر ما إذا كان divisor ليس عاملاً للعدد.

يمكننا التحقق مما إذا كان divisor ليس عاملاً للعدد عن طريق حساب باقي قسمة العدد على divisor. [[LINE05.EXPL2]] يتكرر جسم حلقة while طالما أن divisor ليس عاملاً للعدد. تتوقف الحلقة عندما تُقيّم حالة الحلقة لتكون False، أي عندما يكون divisor عاملاً للعدد.
في هذا البرنامج، تنفذ حلقة while مرة واحدة وتحدّث قيمة divisor إلى 3. بعد ذلك تتوقف الحلقة عن التكرار لأن 3 هو عامل للعدد 15 وستُقيّم حالة الحلقة لتصبح False. [[LINE05.EXPL3]] لاحظ أيضًا أن العامل % يُرجع باقي القسمة. [[LINE06.EXPL1]] عندما لا يكون divisor عاملاً للعدد، نزيد قيمة المتغير divisor بمقدار 1. [[LINE06.EXPL2]] العامل += يضيف 1 إلى قيمة المتغير divisor ويخزن الناتج مرة أخرى في المتغير divisor. لذا فهو مكافئ عمليًا للعبارة divisor = divisor + 1. [[LINE07.EXPL1]] تطبع هذه العبارة إلى مخرَج المعيار الافتراضي أصغر قاسم للعدد.
